changelog:
Initial public release of Trading Journal.

- Provides concise trade logging, decision checklists, and post-trade reflection workflows.
- Adds weekly/monthly performance reporting, including win rate, P&L, and emotion-result correlation.
- Supports automated pattern recognition (e.g., best/worst time periods, strategy effectiveness).
- Introduces "shadow portfolio" for tracking virtual trades and testing stock selection.
- Simplifies storage to a single workspace location.
